decision_boundary.bar_rule: An 8-hour bar is usable only when open_time plus 8 hours is no later than the decision boundary.
decision_boundary.fill_rule: The executable open at the decision boundary is not an input to the strategy.
decision_boundary.funding_rule: The strategy filters funding_time strictly before the decision boundary.

features.availability_rule: Both adjacent closes are from fully closed 8-hour bars.
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol if closes are insufficient, non-finite, or nonpositive.

features.availability_rule: The 90 aligned returns end before the three-bar impulse and one-bar confirmation.
features.lag: four fully closed 8-hour returns relative to the decision boundary
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol if aligned history is insufficient or BTC variance is at or below 1e-8.
features.transformation: covariance(symbol_return, btc_return) divided by variance(btc_return), clipped to [-1, 3]

features.availability_rule: The 63 residuals end before the three-bar impulse and one-bar confirmation.
features.lag: four fully closed 8-hour returns relative to the decision boundary
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol if sample volatility is non-finite or at or below 1e-8.
features.transformation: sample standard deviation of pre-impulse beta residuals

features.availability_rule: Uses the three fully closed residuals immediately before the confirmation bar.
features.lag: one fully closed confirmation bar relative to the decision boundary
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol when beta, scale, or aligned returns are unavailable.
features.transformation: sum the three beta residuals and divide by pre-impulse residual volatility times square_root(3)

features.availability_rule: Uses only the latest fully closed aligned return after the impulse.
features.lag: available only when the confirmation bar closes at the decision boundary
features.lookback: 1 bar (8 hours), fixed and not tunable
features.missing_rule: Zero, non-finite, or same-sign confirmation makes the symbol ineligible for both sleeves.
features.transformation: long eligibility requires residual_impulse below zero and confirmation residual above zero; short eligibility requires the opposite signs

features.availability_rule: The numerator is the completed impulse-window volume and the baseline ends before the impulse.
features.lag: one fully closed confirmation bar relative to the decision boundary
features.lookback: three-bar impulse sum against 90 pre-impulse completed three-bar sums
features.missing_rule: Omit the symbol for invalid volume, fewer than 30 rolling sums, or a nonpositive baseline median.
features.transformation: log(impulse_volume / pre_impulse_median), clipped to [0, 2], then multiplied by 0.35 and added to one

features.availability_rule: The strategy explicitly keeps only funding_time strictly before the decision boundary.
features.lookback: 3-day mean scaled by sample volatility from up to 30 days
features.missing_rule: Use zero until at least 12 valid events exist or when historical scale is degenerate.
features.transformation: recent mean divided by historical sample standard deviation, clipped to [-3, 3], with weight -0.25 in long desirability

features.availability_rule: Uses BTC returns from fully closed bars only.
features.missing_rule: Use symmetric sleeve gross when history is insufficient or aggregate return is non-finite.
features.transformation: compound 180 log returns; move 0.05 gross toward long above +0.10 or toward short below -0.10

ranking_rule: Count every feature-valid non-BTC symbol in universe breadth. Rank only sign-confirmed longs by descending raw finite score and sign-confirmed shorts by ascending raw finite score, with ascending symbol order only for exact numerical ties. Require both complete tails or request flat.
